environment.description: Service runs on EC2 in private subnet (10.0.128.0/24) with route table containing only local VPC route and NAT gateway for egress. Exposed exclusively through AWS PrivateLink (VPC Endpoint Service) backed by NLB listener on port 443. The NLB target group health-checks port 8080. No internet gateway route exists in the subnet route table. The VPC endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled, meaning only pre-approved AWS accounts (via endpoint connection acceptance) can create interface endpoints to reach the service. The endpoint service's allowed-principals list contains only arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root (the internal monitoring account). DNS resolution for the service returns only the VPC endpoint's private ENI addresses (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e.vpce-svc-0f1g2h3i.us-east-1.vpce.amazonaws.com). No public IP is assigned to the EC2 instance. Security group sg-0def456 allows inbound 8080 only from the NLB's private IPs within the VPC CIDR.

config.deployment: AWS EC2 t3.medium in private subnet 10.0.128.0/24
config.load_balancer: Internal NLB (not internet-facing), target group on port 8080
config.internet_gateway: not attached to private subnet route table
config.dns: private DNS only via VPC endpoint
